problem: Concurrent eligible recoverers can both pass stale/overlap preflight and create separate recovery claims for the same stale opportunity, causing duplicate recovery work and unsafe overlapping write risk.
acceptance: At most one recovery executor acquires the active recovery slot for the same opportunity and stale generation while preserving append-only recovery evidence.
A losing recovery worker records a collision and re-enters allocation without candidate/product writes.
Two-worker and five-worker race tests prove non-duplication under concurrent stale takeover.
Late original returns and late recovery evidence remain preserved and reconcileable.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served, or production authority is promoted.
title: Atomic stale-recovery arbitration after live duplicate takeovers
mission: Add and verify a narrow arbitration primitive for stale recovery so simultaneous eligible recoverers cannot both become active writers for the same opportunity/stale generation. Preserve the existing append-only recovery-claim and late-return model, but introduce an atomic create-if-absent or lease/CAS recovery slot keyed by opportunity plus stale generation. Losing workers must durably record collision/observation and immediately re-enter allocation without product writes. Prove behavior with 2-worker and 5-worker races and reconcile existing duplicate-recovery evidence rather than deleting it.

regression_prevention.reason: Fresh broad-wave evidence shows multiple recovery attempts can be created for one stale opportunity within the same minute; an arbitration primitive directly reduces duplicate writes and recovery storms.

unblock_value.reason: Safer recovery arbitration lets stale gates be recovered aggressively without requiring the human/global guide to serialize recoverers.

information_gain.reason: The 2/5-worker race canary will distinguish harmless append-only duplicate evidence from actual overlapping execution/write risk under mass /wc launches.

fail_if: two simultaneous recoverers can both acquire active write authority for the same opportunity and stale generation
a losing recovery worker performs product/candidate writes before re-entering allocation
original claim/run/return or late recovery evidence is overwritten or deleted
arbitration lock can become permanent without a bounded stale/lease recovery path
